aiThesis.rationale:
## SNDK Thesis Update (July 2, 2026)

### The Fundamental Shift: Long-Term Agreements (LTAs)
SanDisk's investment thesis has been fundamentally de-risked by newly signed 3-5 year Long-Term Agreements (LTAs). As noted by Bernstein, these contracts flip the historical power balance back to the memory producers by locking in fixed pricing, upfront prepayments, and minimum price floors (~$0.29/GB). This dramatically reduces the cyclical volatility of earnings and cash flows, shielding the company's profitability even in a deep memory spot market downturn.

### Agentic Swarm Memory Moat
AI memory demand is transitioning from raw GPU training requirements to sustained inference and agentic swarm execution. The global deployment of parallel sub-agents, loop state caching, continuous trace logging, and vector database embeddings creates a non-linear, cost-effective storage demand profile. High-density TLC/QLC enterprise SSDs are the only viable hardware layer to support this tier, positioning SanDisk directly at the center of the AI memory bottleneck.

### Valuation Committee Summary
- **Bear Scenario ($102.18, 15%)**: NAND pricing contracts early, but LTA floors protect margins at 12%. Present value: $102.18.
- **Base Scenario ($1,397.70, 50%)**: consensus revenue met in Y1 ($19.6B) and Y2 ($44.5B). 58% CAGR, 22% net margin, exit PE 22x. Present value: $1,397.70.
- **Bull Scenario ($4,252.52, 35%)**: Agentic AI swarm demand triggers structural NAND storage deficit. 68% CAGR, 32% net margin, exit PE 28x. Present value: $4,252.52.

**Weighted Fair Value: $2,202.56 (BUY) vs $1,726.81 current price.**
